RESOLUTION NO.
FEDERAL TRANSIT ADMINISTRATION, AN OPERATING ADMINISTRATION OF THE
UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION, FORFEDERAL
TRANSPORTATION ASSISTANCE AUTHORIZED BY TITLE49, UNITED STATES
CODE, SECTION5307."
WHEREAS, the Federal Transportation Administrator has been delegated authority to award Federal
financial assistance for transportation projects pursuant to 49 U.S.C.85307; and
WHEREAS, the grant or cooperative agreement for Federal financial assistance will impose certain
obligations upon the Applicant, and may require the Applicant to provide the local share of the project cost; and
WHEREAS, the Applicant has or will provide all annual certifications and assurances required for the
project to the Federal Transit Administration; and
WHEREAS, the Applicant willapply to the Federal Transit Administration(FTA)for$1,110,189of
FTASection5307funding received fromformula apportionment s by the Moving Ahead for Progress inthe 21st
Century Act (MAP-21), and the Federal Register, the amount of$695,184for operating expenses and$415,005
for capital replacement expensesfor transit services provided by the Cheyenne Transit Program, ona cost share
basis.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE CITY OF
CHEYENNE, WYOMING:
1.That the Mayor is authorized to execute and file an application for Federal financial assistance on
behalf of the City of Cheyenne and the Cheyenne Transit Program, with the Federal Transit Administration, as
authorized by 49 U.s.C.$5307.
2.That the Mayor is authorized to execute and file with the application the annual certifications and
assurances and other documents the Federal Transit Administration requires before awarding a Federal
assistance grant or cooperative agreement.
3.That themayoris authorized to execute grant and cooperative agreements with the Federal Transit
Administration on behalf of the City of Cheyenne and the Cheyenne Transit Program.
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED, that Richard L.Kaysen, Mayor, is designated as the authorized
representative of the City of Cheyenne to act on behalf of the Governing Body on all matters relating to this
grant application.
PRESENTED, READ AND ADOPTED THIS
DAY OF
2013.
Richard L.Kaysen, Mayor
